source.text: Uber Sydney trips from CBD will be free for riders. Higher rates are still in place to encourage drivers to get into the CBD.

selection_rule: Kept 30 comments with explicit support or opposition to the source tweet explaining that Uber Sydney rides from the CBD would be free for riders while higher driver rates stayed in place to attract drivers. Excluded neutral clarification questions, source-authored customer-service replies, logistics-only boundary/wait-time questions, and off-topic taxi/public-transport debates; balanced 15 support and 15 oppose.
note: support = accepts Uber explanation as a useful correction, good gesture, or reasonable driver incentive while riders pay nothing; oppose = treats the policy or messaging as crisis surge pricing, price gouging, poor communication, or a backtrack after backlash.
